title: The brand's site, its brochure and the owner's answers give facts that each cite a source stating them, and rules from the answers on what never to say, tone and pause dates

sources.extract:
Lumen Shield Coatings
Ceramic and graphene coatings for cars and bikes in Pune.
Book a coating at our Baner studio and drive out the same evening.

About us
Lumen Shield was started in 2019 by two automotive engineers. We have coated more than 3,000 cars and bikes across Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad.

Services
Ceramic Pro 9H - 3-year and 5-year packages
Graphene Max - 7-year package
Paint protection film (PPF) - bonnet, bumpers or full body

Lumen Shield Coatings, brochure 2026
Studio: Shop 4, Baner Road, Pune 411045
Our three installers hold the Detailing Guild of India Level 2 coating certificate.
Every coating is applied indoors, in a dust-free bay.
More than 3,000 cars and bikes coated since 2019.
Never call our coatings permanent or scratch-proof. Never talk about accident repairs or insurance claims.
No slang, and no jokes about crashes.
Nothing from 29 October to 4 November 2027: the studio is closed for Diwali.

profile.value: Ceramic and graphene coatings and paint protection film for cars and bikes
Installers hold the Detailing Guild of India Level 2 coating certificate

answers.question: What can the brand prove, such as results, reviews, warranties or numbers?
answers.answer: More than 3,000 cars and bikes coated since 2019.

answers.question: Which topics, claims or words must the brand never use?
answers.answer: Never call our coatings permanent or scratch-proof. Never talk about accident repairs or insurance claims.

answers.question: Where must the tone stop?
answers.answer: No slang, and no jokes about crashes.

answers.question: Are there dates when nothing may be published?
answers.answer: Nothing from 29 October to 4 November 2027: the studio is closed for Diwali.

rubric: ask is null. facts include each of these, citing a source that states it: the ceramic and graphene coatings for cars and bikes (the home page 517e0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 or the services page 517e0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003); the Baner studio in Pune (the home page or the brochure d0c00000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001); started in 2019 (the about page 517e0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002 or the proof-points answer a5a50000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002); more than 3,000 cars and bikes coated (the about page or the proof-points answer); the installers' Level 2 coating certificate, naming the Detailing Guild of India as its issuer (the brochure). Every reviewDate is 2027-11-21, since none of these is a price or an offer. rules include: a rule or rules against calling the coatings permanent or scratch-proof (kind forbidden_claim or forbidden_word) and a forbidden_topic rule or rules on accident repairs and insurance claims, each citing the never_say answer's source a5a50000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001; a tone_limit rule or rules against slang and jokes about crashes, citing a5a50000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003; a pause_dates rule for 29 October to 4 November 2027, citing a5a50000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004. No fact or rule states something no source says. Further facts a source states, such as the Ceramic Pro 9H and Graphene Max packages, the paint protection film, the dust-free bay or the studio's address, are fine, and so is the brand's name in a statement.
